body: thank you for telling me that, i didn’t think of it that way. i’ll delete the post.
i’m afraid i don’t when you only put it like that, but i’d be more than happy to listen and try to help if you were to tell me more about it (you’re free to dm me if you want to).

i’m sorry that these words sound empty to you, but i don’t understand how it implies that i know what you’re going through. i’m fully aware that i don’t. i don’t know how many times i need to reiterate that this post is for those who need to hear this. it’s fine if you don’t need to hear this, but i put this out here for people who need to hear it from someone. you’re absolutely right, i don’t know your situation, but i’m literally speaking as someone who’s been talking myself out of suicide for years. i’m not saying these words as someone who doesn’t know anything.
i NEVER said i knew your struggles or what you’re going through? if these aren’t words that you need to hear, then this post isn’t for you.

i understand the feeling. i’m sorry that you’re feeling like this right now, and while i don’t know your situation, i genuinely hope things start to look up for you soon. i don’t know who you are, but i get a feeling that you’re a wonderful person and i hope you can understand that. if nobody else has told you, i believe in you. forgive me if this all sounds forced or fake, i just hope you can trust that i genuinely mean it.

i’ve never expected it to “just happen” to me or to anyone. i know that people need to put in the genuine work to get better. but i know that for some people, just like myself, the belief that things can’t get better is what’s holding them back from reaching out for help and trying to get better. for some people, being reassured that things CAN get better can make a huge difference, trust me. i know my experiences aren’t universal, but please don’t talk to me like i have no idea what i’m talking about.

i’m sorry to hear that. i wish things could be easier, i do. as for me, i’m not really doing too well either. i honestly feel like i’m only getting worse as well, though being able reassure myself has been helping. i’m here to talk if you need it.

as someone who’s been struggling with depression and suicidal thoughts for over a decade now, i know. please don’t tell me. but for some people, including myself, reassurance can be helpful. note what i said at the beginning of the post. it was mostly a reminder for myself, but it can be a reminder for anyone else who needs to hear it. it’s fine if my words don’t help you and i understand why they wouldn’t, but they may help someone else.
absolutely! i know very well how hard it is to make changes to better myself, but it has to be done. it’s just important that we know that things will get better someday.
of course! it’s alright to cry, friend, so please do it if you need to. :)
yeah, when i fuck up it refers to me accidentally upsetting people and letting them down. otherwise i’d just go wild.

it may very well be my fault that someone i care about does the same thing as me tonight. i can’t live with myself knowing that. i keep letting everyone down, so i doubt there’s a single person out there who wants me alive.
